Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn

Record Class OWEDependencies

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.OWEDependencies
public record OWEDependencies(ProcessDefinitionService processDefinitionService, ProcessInstanceService processInstanceService, DecisionDefinitionService decisionDefinitionService, DecisionInstanceService decisionInstanceService, EventRegisterService eventRegisterService, NodeExecutorRegistry executorRegistry, ServiceTaskHandlerAdapter serviceTaskHandlerAdapter, IncidentEventHandlerAdapter incidentEventHandlerAdapter, io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.repository.MessageEventRepository messageEventRepository, io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.repository.SignalEventRepository signalEventRepository, UserTaskService userTaskService, io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics.MetricsRecorder metricsRecorder) extends Record
Bundles every collaborator that OrchestWorkflowEngine needs at construction time. metricsRecorder is non-null in every well-wired runtime — modules that do not run the engine (e.g. orchest-rest, sentinel) pass NoOpMetricsRecorder.INSTANCE.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).

      Returns:
